Formal implementation and reproducibility disposition: BLOCK cand-6ZRVTS6MW6DT2N6GQT93M84D14.

Identity and clean checks
- Reviewed exact commit f4a2195d5599c7ded2e7882390cca68c40ab5bbf, parent 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5, tree 705191a284b85cf8fd6cbe48162ae09f8a963987 in disposable clone /private/tmp/storyatlas-mockup-successor-review.F5vRs6/repo.
- Diff scope is exactly mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2; git diff --check is clean. Exact source/output inventory matches the manifest at 25/29 with no missing or extra paths.
- node mockups/v2/verify-manifest.cjs passed with artifact 9410df0b9cb9af9d352b2bbf037e3f24decdd15d6d2656c7b31289092d13c1d6 and reproducible ded486a6777467ce4f8bdd6577af11f8980b3f823dea3e7fb39baef6b2165441. fixture-court passed all three synthetic fixture identities and killed its source mutation. Two exact node mockups/v2/export.cjs regenerations passed all 13 plate courts and reproduced both signed digests. Required browser audits before and after reported no automated top-level browser process.
- Prior I1 strict directive dispatch is repaired: supported nesting renders, unknown kind and sc-unless fail closed, and partial-list mutation is killed. The explicit artboard root and sibling/overflow baseline are also repaired. The v2 digest rules now authenticate their declared artifact and reproducible targets.

BLOCKER I2b: a valid inner scroll-region exempts exact evidence from every outer clipping ancestor, so the court certifies a visibly empty Codex.

Implicated logic: mockups/v2/export.cjs:315-329 excludes an evidence item whenever item.closest(data-dc-scroll-region) exists, without asking whether an outer overflow hidden/clip ancestor clips that region. Lines 331-352 scroll and intersect only the item and its nearest enumerated region; they never intersect the cumulative clipping chain or artboard. PROOF-BOUNDARY.md:35 claims no content-bearing exact-evidence region is silently clipped.

Killing-capacity counterexample, run only in disposable mutation clone /private/tmp/storyatlas-mockup-successor-review.F5vRs6/mut-clip:
1. In Compact.dc.html, wrap compact-codex in an outer height:1px; overflow:hidden; flex:none div.
2. Give the inner valid data-dc-scroll-region a 200px height and keep overflow-y:auto.
3. Run node mockups/v2/export.cjs unpiped.

Observed exit 0; every plate court passed. The mutant Compact receipt says observationChecks s01 through s10, clippedEvidence [], reachability [compact-codex], offenders [], and 1280x800 artboard/scroll. Its PNG visibly contains an empty Codex body while the footer still says 10 of 10 loaded and s10 reachable. Mutant signed digests were artifact c7a7dc8b4fcb0b2ef62b521872b4a12b54b7f90dd6a5038f925bd8385ebdf5f4 and reproducible cc5b89fe993e0fb90359a59911059808992f0a714fbf34609ae54266ab27339f.

Required acceptance check: for each exact-evidence element, including a clipping element itself, traverse ancestors through the artboard and compute cumulative visible bounds. A scroll-region may excuse overflow internal to that region only; it may not excuse clipping by ancestors outside it. After scrollIntoView, require meaningful visibility against the scroll viewport, every outer clipping ancestor, and the artboard. Add the one-pixel outer-clip mutant and prove the court fails. A one-pixel rectangle intersection is not meaningful reachability.

BLOCKER I3b: standalone manifest verification authenticates a reproducible claim but does not establish that the reproducible projection describes the actual bytes.

Implicated logic: mockups/v2/manifest-digest.cjs:86-95 recomputes both target digests, but lines 96-97 verify files only from artifact.sources and artifact.outputs. It never verifies reproducible.sources or reproducible.outputs, recomputes reproducible.sourceSetDigest, or checks that those projections equal the declared projection of artifact. export.cjs:647-689 gives these fields concrete byte/source-set meaning; PROOF-BOUNDARY.md:38-40 says the manifest binds every source and output byte.

Independent in-memory mutations from the exact manifest, each followed by recomputing the declared reproducibleDigest, all SURVIVED verifyManifest:
- reproducible.sourceSetDigest replaced by 64 zeroes -> verifier returned reproducible e67aa481234a4413d8e6587ae83a0a4f15b492e6626fd01ad71a8d291d69a06c;
- reproducible.sources[0].sha256 replaced by 64 zeroes -> f2fe1cf03ec8f34384cedbb24bf5390c54c3d378276f4a75a565a855ff7bd538;
- reproducible.outputs[0].sha256 replaced by 64 zeroes -> 65034f112882c8634e34d9d0358bf54b26d5861efbc4e039903ee87f2f94c3d2.
In all three cases artifact verification still reported the exact candidate artifact digest and counts 25/29. The exact candidate manifest is internally correct; the blocker is that its advertised verifier can certify a false reproducible receipt.

Required acceptance check: verify every reproducible source/output entry against actual bytes, recompute sourceSetDigest from the verified source list, and enforce the intended reproducible projection from artifact rather than trusting two independent arrays. Add reauthenticated mutations for sourceSetDigest and a reproducible-only file hash; both must fail. Also retain the existing digest-rule mutation to distinguish authentication from byte/projection verification.

No authorization or landing action was taken. This is an advisory implementation/reproducibility block; science and UX remain independent review registers.
